title: Baby Playing Upright Piano, Living Room - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century domestic snapshot featuring an infant in light-colored footie pajamas perched on a piano bench, enthusiastically touching the keys of an upright piano. Displayed on the music rack are several pieces of sheet music, including 'Play by Color' and 'All Alone'. The cozy living room background includes floral patterned drapes, horizontal window blinds, and an end table with a stylized lamp and framed portrait. The square print has classic deckled edges typical of 1950s consumer photographic prints.
